back.en: All chemical reactions in an organism = anabolism + catabolism
back.bm: Semua tindak balas kimia dalam organisma = anabolisme + katabolisme

back.en: Builds complex molecules, uses energy (photosynthesis, protein synthesis)
back.bm: Membina molekul kompleks, guna tenaga (fotosintesis, sintesis protein)

back.en: Breaks down molecules, releases energy (respiration, digestion)
Proteins, specific, speed up reactions, unchanged, reusable, affected by temperature and pH
back.bm: Protein, spesifik, mempercepat tindak balas, tidak berubah, boleh diguna semula, dipengaruhi suhu dan pH

back.en: Substrate (key) fits the active site (lock) to form an enzyme–substrate complex
back.bm: Substrat (kunci) sepadan dengan tapak aktif (mangga) membentuk kompleks enzim–substrat

back.en: Intracellular: work inside the cell (e.g. respiration enzymes). Extracellular: secreted out (e.g. digestive enzymes)
back.bm: Intrasel: berfungsi dalam sel (cth. enzim respirasi). Ekstrasel: dirembes keluar (cth. enzim pencernaan)

back.en: Above optimum: bonds break, active site changes shape → denatured (permanent)
back.bm: Melebihi optimum: ikatan putus, tapak aktif berubah bentuk → ternyahasli (kekal)

back.en: Enzyme inactive but not denatured — works again when warmed
back.bm: Enzim tidak aktif tetapi tidak ternyahasli — berfungsi semula apabila dipanaskan

back.en: Pepsin 2, salivary amylase 7, trypsin and lipase ~8
back.bm: Pepsin 2, amilase liur 7, tripsin dan lipase ~8

back.en: Ribosomes on rough ER → transport vesicle → Golgi apparatus → secretory vesicle → exocytosis
back.bm: Ribosom pada JE kasar → vesikel angkutan → jasad Golgi → vesikel rembesan → eksositosis

back.en: Papain/bromelain (tenderise meat), pectinase (juice), rennin (cheese), lactase (lactose-free milk), amylase (bread, syrup)
back.bm: Papain/bromelain (lembutkan daging), pektinase (jus), renin (keju), laktase (susu tanpa laktosa), amilase (roti, sirap)

back.en: Biological detergents (protease, lipase), leather softening (trypsin), glucose test strips (glucose oxidase)
back.bm: Detergen biologi (protease, lipase), melembutkan kulit (tripsin), jalur ujian glukosa (glukosa oksidase)

back.en: The active site changes shape slightly so it fits the substrate tightly when it binds
back.bm: Tapak aktif berubah sedikit bentuknya supaya padan rapat dengan substrat apabila substrat terikat

tip.bm: Kunci dan mangga = tegar; padanan teraruh = fleksibel.

back.en: Rate rises until every active site is busy, then levels off (enzyme concentration becomes the limit)
back.bm: Kadar meningkat sehingga semua tapak aktif digunakan, kemudian mendatar (kepekatan enzim menjadi faktor pengehad)

back.en: Usually substrate + "-ase": lipase (lipids), protease (proteins), amylase (starch), sucrase (sucrose)
back.bm: Biasanya substrat + "-ase": lipase (lipid), protease (protein), amilase (kanji), sukrase (sukrosa)
